scripts.bundle-libs: npm run bundle-libs-core && npm run bundle-libs-codec && npm run bundle-libs-preview && npm run bundle-libs-readability
scripts.bundle-libs-core:
esbuild libraries.js --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --outfile=libraries.bundle.js --loader:.wasm=dataurl --external:fs --external:path --banner:js='// @ts-nocheck
// Auto-generated bundle of UI dependencies'
scripts.bundle-libs-codec:
esbuild vendor.codec.js --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --outfile=vendor.codec.bundle.js --loader:.wasm=dataurl --external:fs --external:path --define:process=undefined --banner:js='// @ts-nocheck
// Auto-generated bundle of codec dependencies (zstd + argon2)'
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:site && npm run deploy:sandbox
scripts.deploy:site: npm run build && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.site.toml
